items.title: Bernstein remains bullish on SpaceX but sees challenges in telecom ambitions
items.summary: The analysis carries clear implications for U.S. incumbent carriers AT&T (NYSE: T), Verizon (NYSE: VZ), and T-Mobile (NASDAQ: TMUS), all of which face the prospect of a SpaceX-led mobile entrant and currently invest double-digit billions of dollars annually to maintain nationwide LTE and 5G coverage.
